sources.claim: The visible upload button clicks one hidden file input whose change event calls onFileSelected.
The handler selects the first file and dispatches it to the upload routine; the routine uses the current folder upload link and refreshes after finalization.
The draft custom step obtains filesLink and projectId from branchedFrom.
New-file upload adds kind=file and the filename before delegating to the raw PUT service.
The raw upload operation is an HTTP PUT with progress events.
The HTTP interceptor attaches session and CSRF behavior internally and enables credentialed requests.
A new upload is a PUT to a folder upload relation with kind=file and name; success is 201 and a same-name conflict is 409. Updating an existing file uses its upload relation and returns 200.
Provider handlers validate, authenticate, construct the provider and path, then prepare the stream before storage handling.
File create prevalidation requires a valid Content-Length and kind.

sourceAcquisition: Read-only shallow clones of the public authoritative repositories were inspected in a temporary non-repository directory. No dependency was acquired or installed.
